about: The RuneScape Wiki's {{MMGWarning}} on money making guides: "The methods described in this guide may involve considerable risks, including (but not limited to): loss of money and goods, price volatility, and low GE sales volume." Each entry is a guide page's reason, read from the revision in guides.jsonl; an empty reason means the Wiki gives none. It covers every version on the page.

warnings.reason: Unchecked dinosaurs are traded at a much lower value than their Grand Exchange guide price would suggest.

warnings.page: Money making guide/Blessing extra fine sand
warnings.reason: This method may not work all the time.

warnings.page: Money making guide/Buying construction materials from Bandit Duty Free
warnings.reason: You need to be skulled to enter, causing you to lose all supplies if you are killed by another player. Construction materials consistently sell far below the GE guide price. The large amount of starting cash and small profit margins may cause you to waste nearly all of the GP spent on items with deflated resale value.
The resource may have low trade volume. The guide price may be overestimated or underestimated.

warnings.page: Money making guide/Charging inert adrenaline crystals
warnings.reason: Be wary, prices can change on this method heavily affecting profitability. These prices can be unstable and may be subject to heavy market fluctuations. Confirm that the market price is accurate before investing heavily into this method
